cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've put your usual mug out. We can still have tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Still? Are you cross with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'm hoping you won't leave me cross.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you feel that way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you try one where you're sorry about yourself? I'll keep the tea warm.

mechanism: A copies a supposed formal speaking cue while using the moment to seek an unnamed apology.
confusable: S04 must mistake the actual cue, not simply imitate a confident tone; D03 must not name the offense.
comparison: Public meal timing contrasts with an office presentation repair.
seedUse: Use D03-a insisting on actual remorse rather than feeling apology, with S04 misread gesture.
